Hi Evelyn / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Atlas Integrators is ready to move to a joint co-sell demo focused on our data-migration use case with Redwood (we'll be demoing a PoC that highlights cross-cloud routing and cost controls). Two asks before we lock a customer-facing slot: 

- Can we schedule a 60–90 minute technical dry-run with your SI host and an AWS SI engineer?
- Please share the runbook/agenda so our pre-sales engineer can prep.

Our team availability (PST): Tue 21 Sep 14:00-17:00 or Wed 22 Sep 00:00-04:00 (this maps to APAC mornings). If those don't work we can be flexible — we need one APAC-friendly slot for the customer.

Attaching a short internal checklist on compliance attendees (they may ask to sit in). CC'd is Priya (technical lead).

Thanks — Samir

We can do a 75-minute dry-run. Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 21 Sep 15:00-16:15 PT (APAC morning overlap)
- Wed 22 Sep 00:30-01:45 PT (earlier APAC slot)

Alex (our SI host) will join the dry-run and I asked Vanessa to prep a runbook. Vanessa — can you attach the latest runbook and an unlockable agenda (we may need a 30m customer-facing version too)?

If either of those slots works for you, confirm and I'll send calendar invites with the runbook attached.
